## Review lenses

Each lens gets its own review comment on the PR. Findings are fixed in follow-up commits or split into issues.

- [ ] Architecture and code quality
- [ ] iOS UX and accessibility (VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion)
- [ ] Duo layouts (size classes, fold region, outer and inner display)
- [ ] Performance (main thread, memory, large libraries)
- [ ] Privacy and security (network calls, file handling, privacy manifest)
- [ ] Tests
